mapper.sql: select d.deliverable_id, d.group_id, d.task_id, d.deliverable_name, d.requirement, d.required_num, d.archived_num, d.deadline, d.is_required, d.status, d.finish_time, d.sort, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_by, d.update_time, d.remark, t.task_name from task_deliverable d inner join task_info t on t.task_id = d.task_id and t.del_flag = '0' where d.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into task_deliverable (group_id, task_id, deliverable_name, requirement, required_num, archived_num, deadline, is_required, status, finish_time, sort, create_by, create_time, remark, del_flag) values (#{groupId}, #{taskId}, #{deliverableName}, #{requirement}, #{requiredNum}, #{archivedNum}, #{deadline}, #{isRequired}, #{status}, #{finishTime}, #{sort}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark}, '0')
mapper.update: update task_deliverable set deliverable_name = #{deliverableName}, requirement = #{requirement}, required_num = #{requiredNum}, archived_num = #{archivedNum}, deadline = #{deadline}, is_required = #{isRequired}, status = #{status}, finish_time = #{finishTime}, sort = #{sort}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark} where deliverable_id = #{deliverableId} and group_id = #{groupId} and task_id = #{taskId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select count(1) from task_submission where deliverable_id = #{deliverableId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update task_deliverable set del_flag = '2', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where deliverable_id = #{deliverableId} and del_flag = '0'
